Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the left hemithorax with a shift of the trachea and mediastinum to the right, which indicates a space-occupying process like a large pleural effusion rather than lung collapse (which would pull structures toward the affected side). Among the choices provided, this presentation is most consistent with a large effusion secondary to malignancy such as pleural metastases.
